source_citation: Malo, P., Sinha, A., Korhonen, P., Wallenius, J., & Takala, P. (2014). Good debt or bad debt: Detecting semantic orientations in economic texts. Journal of the Association for Information Science and Technology, 65(4), 782-796.
justification: Selected the 100% agreement subset (AllAgree) to establish an unambiguous, zero-noise gold standard. Sentences with lower agreement (50%, 66%, 75%) contain subjective or ambiguous financial framing that introduces inter-annotator noise. Unanimous consensus guarantees that evaluation errors reflect true model classification failure.
